problems.explain: f(g(x)) is f with every x replaced by the whole of g(x), x − 2, in brackets: f(g(x)) = (x − 2)² − 2. (x − 2)² is (x − 2)(x − 2), not each term squared. Multiply out and collect: f(g(x)) = x² − 4x + 2. (x² − 4 is g(f(x)), the other order; x³ − 2x² − 2x + 4 is f(x) · g(x), a product, not a composition; x² + x − 4 is f(x) + g(x).)
